WITH pattern_means AS (
  SELECT "ANA Pattern" AS pattern, AVG("aCL IgG") AS avg_igg
  FROM Examination
  WHERE "ANA Pattern" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY "ANA Pattern"
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS mean_of_pattern_means
  FROM pattern_means
),
above_mean AS (
  SELECT pattern, avg_igg, avg_igg - mean_of_pattern_means AS excess
  FROM pattern_means CROSS JOIN overall_mean
  WHERE avg_igg > mean_of_pattern_means
),
mean_excess AS (
  SELECT AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM above_mean
)
SELECT above_mean.pattern, above_mean.avg_igg, above_mean.excess,
       above_mean.avg_igg - mean_excess.avg_excess AS result
FROM above_mean CROSS JOIN mean_excess
